page.layout: One page of running text, no margins. Sections LVI to LXIII, each with a centred Roman numeral above its paragraph. Catchword "Ex" at lower right, gathering signature "B 2" at foot centre.

main_text.p: Quibus autem primò competat, satis constat: hæ enim sunt ARITHMETICA, & GEOMETRIA. Pure ob id etiam Mathematicæ scientiæ communiter dictæ.
Ad certum verò physicum subiectum si restringatur, MUSICA, STEREOMETRIA, OPTICA, CA-TOPTRICA, SCIATERICA, GEODETICA, ASTRONOMIA, & similes exoriuntur.

p.i: De Subalternatione duorum priorum, assenserunt nobiles Philosophi, subactioris tamen iudicij nobis esse videtur, qui tuentur partem utramq;.

main_text.p: Quæ igitur in hoc philosophiarum genere sit contemplationis ratio, in confesso apparet. Abstrahentium nō est mentiri.2.prim philos.
ARITHMETICA & GEOMETRIA cùm in quî busuis citò, tutò, iucundè dinumerandis commensuran-disq; suas partes tueantur, in immensum earum diffusa utilitas conspicitur.
Has igitur merito geminas Plato credidit alas, Quæ nostros animos ardua ad astra vehant.

p.i: Verùm de illis, totaq; scientiæ Mathematicæ constitu-tione & usu, aliàs dicendi locus erit amplissimus: nunc verò de singulis quædam tantummodò, ἐν παρόδῳ.

main_text.p: Nobilis Arithmetica, ratione Subiecti, in Absolutam & Comparatam rectè diducta. Quarum hæc Notatione, & Numeratione tum integrorum tum partium constat: illa verò τῷ λόγῳ, καὶ τῆς ἀναλογίας comparatione.

page.notes: Printing error: section number printed "LIIX." (for LVIII) and left as printed. Section numbers are bare numerals, written as paragraphs. The ornamental flourish before "Arithmetica" in LXIII and the large decorative initials N and Q are not transcribed. Greek words in LXII and LXIII were copied from the scan; the Greek accents are not fully certain.
